name: i-vocabulary
description: 英会話のための英単語学習アプリ (Web + API server, future iOS client)

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web
scripts.test: npm test -w shared && npm test -w server && npm test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.deploy: npm run build -w web && npm run deploy -w server
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build -w web && npm run dev:worker -w server
